Name: Elle's Cuter Foliage
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1772423597-629964777.png[/img]﻿
[Alt text: A dark green banner with text that reads "Stardew Valley Modfest!"]

Happy 10th birthday to Stardew Valley!! The first mod I ever made was in 2016, just some months after the game released. I'm so grateful to have been able to play this game and make content for it for so long. Thank you to everyone who has been a part of my modding journey over the years. 💚

To celebrate, I decided to make something new: I'm trying my hand at a foliage mod! This is a work in progress, so it isn't yet feature complete. I'll be updating it as I can throughout the modfest (and likely after), but I wanted to make it available for the celebration!


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1772423597-1293596207.png[/img]
[Alt text: A light green banner with text that reads "Features"]

Current features:
﻿- Maple, oak, and pine trees for all seasons (and their mossy variants)
﻿- Mushroom and mystic trees (which also now change color seasonally)
﻿- Fully grown cherry, apricot, peach, orange, pomegranate, and apple trees
﻿- Mahogany trees
﻿- Most bushes found in town
﻿- Optional flower overlays for bushes
﻿- Artifact and seed dig spots
﻿- Debris (rocks, stumps, logs) and some weeds
﻿- Some of the ambient flowers/plants
﻿- A version for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]
﻿- A version for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]grapeponta's Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]

Planned features:
﻿- Banana and mango trees
﻿- Growth stages of all fruit trees
﻿- Special green rain tree variants
﻿- Any remaining trees and bushes
﻿- Different, leafless variants of trees in winter (currently all trees keep their leaves)
﻿- More flowers and plants
﻿- Compatibility with other map recolor mods
﻿- ...and more!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1772423595-360909346.png[/img]﻿
[Alt text: An orange banner with text that reads "How to Install:"]

[b]1[/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b]2[/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b]3[/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b]4[/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.[b]
5[/b]. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the images in the 'references' folder to change each bush and tree to your liking. If you can't get a config.json to generate, you can rename the example_config.json to config.json and use it instead. If you want to skip this step (because it's a lot of options), feel free to just use the default options!
[b]6[/b]. Run the game using SMAPI to play with your new foliage!

If using the optional AT version of trees, you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Scarlett28/mods]Scarlet28 [/url]for the AT pack of the trees!
